arxiv-2201-07261.description: Abstract The spatial inhomogeneity is one of the important features for understanding the reionization process; however, it has not yet been fully quantified. To map this inhomogeneous distribution, we simultaneously detect Ly α \alpha emitters (LAEs) and Lyman break galaxies (LBGs) at z ∼ 6.6 z\sim 6.6 from the Subaru/Hyper Suprime-Cam (HSC) large-area ( ∼ 1.

arxiv-2208-06753.title: Sharp Frequency Bounds for Sample-Based Queries PubID: pubid: 978-1-7281-0858-2/19/$31.00 ©2019 IEEE
arxiv-2208-06753.creator: Eric Bax, John Donald
arxiv-2208-06753.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Eric Bax, John Donald. A data sketch algorithm scans a big data set, collecting a small amount of data – the sketch, which can be used to statistically infer properties of the big data set. Some data sketch algorithms take a fixed-size random sample of a big data set, and use that sample to infer frequencies of items that meet various criteria in the big data set.

arxiv-2304-00431.title: Electromagnetic Properties of Aluminum-based Bilayers for Kinetic Inductance Detectors Thanks: Manuscript receipt and acceptance dates will be inserted here. Work at Argonne, including use of the Center for Nanoscale Materials, an Office of Science user facility, was supported by the U.S. Department
arxiv-2304-00431.creator: G. Wang, P. S. Barry, T. Cecil, C. L. Chang, J. Li, M. Lisovenko, V. Novosad, Z. Pan
arxiv-2304-00431.description: Abstract The complex conductivity of a superconducting thin film is related to the quasiparticle density, which depends on the physical temperature and can also be modified by external pair breaking with photons and phonons. This relationship forms the underlying operating principle of Kinetic Inductance Detectors (KIDs), where the detection threshold is governed by the superconducting energy gap.

arxiv-2402-11564.title: The Properties of Radially Excited Charmonia in the Light Front Quark Model
arxiv-2402-11564.creator: \firstname Muhammad Ridwan, \firstname Ahmad Jafar Arifi, \firstname Terry Mart
arxiv-2402-11564.description: Abstract Investigating the properties of excited charmonia is important to clarify its internal structure. In this paper, we present the mass spectra (MS) and decay constants (DC) for charmonia up to 3 S S states calculated by means of the light-front quark model based on a variational approach.

arxiv-2406-07736.title: MultiPragEval: Multilingual Pragmatic Evaluation of Large Language Models
arxiv-2406-07736.creator: Dojun Park, Jiwoo Lee, Hyeyun Jeong, Seohyun Park, Youngeun Koo, Soonha Hwang, Seonwoo Park, Sungeun Lee
arxiv-2406-07736.description: Abstract As the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) expand, it becomes increasingly important to evaluate them beyond basic knowledge assessment, focusing on higher-level language understanding. This study introduces MultiPragEval, the first multilingual pragmatic evaluation of LLMs, designed for English, German, Korean, and Chinese.

arxiv-2411-13218.title: On Minimal and Minimum Cylindrical Algebraic Decompositions
arxiv-2411-13218.creator: Lucas Michel, Pierre Mathonet, Naïm Zénaïdi
arxiv-2411-13218.description: Abstract . We consider cylindrical algebraic decompositions (CADs) as a tool for representing semi-algebraic subsets of ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} . In this framework, a CAD 𝒞 \mathscr{C} is adapted to a given set S S if S S is a union of cells of 𝒞 \mathscr{C} .

arxiv-2502-08901.title: Bose-Einstein condensation of five α \alpha clusters in 20 Ne and supersolidity
arxiv-2502-08901.creator: S. Ohkubo, J. Takahashi, Y. Yamanaka
arxiv-2502-08901.description: Abstract We show that the five α \alpha cluster states recently observed in 20 Ne, slightly above the five α \alpha threshold energy, are Bose-Einstein condensates of five α \alpha clusters. The states are described well using a superfluid cluster model, where the order parameter is defined. We suggest that the the five α \alpha states are fragmented.

arxiv-2506-15640.title: Publication type: Review Article
arxiv-2506-15640.creator: Dario Borrelli
arxiv-2506-15640.description: Abstract In recent decades, it has been emphasized that the evolving structure of networks may be shaped by interaction principles that yield sparse graphs with a vertex degree distribution exhibiting an algebraic tail, and other structural traits that are not featured in traditional random graphs.

arxiv-2509-12264.title: Dynamics of test particles, QPOs and thermodynamics of charged Euler-Heisenberg AdS black holes with a cloud of strings and dark matter
arxiv-2509-12264.description: Abstract We investigate the geodesic motion of test particles around a charged Euler-Heisenberg Anti-de Sitter black hole (CEH-AdS-BH) with a cloud of strings (CoS) and surrounded by perfect fluid dark matter (PFDM). Our analysis examines how the interplay between Euler-Heisenberg nonlinear electrodynamic corrections, string cloud, and PFDM distributions modifies fundamental BH properties.

arxiv-2602-03033.title: Layered Modal ML: Syntax and Full Abstraction
arxiv-2602-03033.creator: Haoxuan Yin, Andrzej S. Murawski, C.-H. Luke Ong
arxiv-2602-03033.description: Abstract . MetaML-style metaprogramming languages allow programmers to construct, manipulate and run code. In the presence of higher-order references for code, ensuring type safety is challenging, as free variables can escape their binders. In this paper, we present Layered Modal ML (LMML), the first metaprogramming language that supports storing and running open code under a strong type safety guarantee .

britannica-1911-tallage.title: Tallage (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-tallage.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-tallage.description: Article 'Tallage' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. tailler, to cut, classical Lat. talea, a cutting, slip; cf. “tally” and the French x taille Taille, q.v.), a special tax in England paid by cities, boroughs and royal demesnes. The word, variously interpreted as a part “cut off” from the property taxed, or as derived from the x tally Tally (q.v.), first appears in the reign of Henry II.

europmc-pmc7779012.title: The Gene Ontology resource: enriching a GOld mine.
europmc-pmc7779012.creator: Gene Ontology Consortium.
europmc-pmc7779012.description: The Gene Ontology Consortium (GOC) provides the most comprehensive resource currently available for computable knowledge regarding the functions of genes and gene products. Here, we report the advances of the consortium over the past two years. The new GO-CAM annotation...

pmc-11396686.title: Effect of histidine and L-Tyrosine supplementation in maturation medium on in-vitro developmental outcomes of buffalo oocytes
pmc-11396686.creator: Eman M Abu El-Naga, Montaser Elsayed Ali, Ramya A Sindi, Hassan A Hussein
pmc-11396686.description: The present study was designed to investigate the effects of amino acid (histidine and L-Tyrosine) on in vitro maturation (IVM), in vitro fertilization (IVF), cleavage (CR) rates, and in vitro embryonic cultivation (IVC; Morula and Blastocyst stage) in buffaloes. Within two hours of buffalo slaughter, the ovaries were collected and transported to the laboratory.

pmc-11399203.title: Matched Comparison Examining the Effect of Obesity on Clinical, Economic, and Humanistic Outcomes in Patients with Bipolar I Disorder
pmc-11399203.creator: Michael J. Doane, Adam Jauregui, Hemangi R. Panchmatia
pmc-11399203.description: IntroductionBipolar I disorder (BD-I) is associated with an increased risk of obesity, but few studies have evaluated the real-world clinical, humanistic, and economic effects associated with obesity in people with BD-I.MethodsThis was a retrospective, cross-sectional analysis of responses to the 2016 and 2020 National Health and Wellness surveys.

pmc-11703396.title: Artificial intelligence (AI)-powered bibliometric analysis of global trends in mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs)-derived exosome research: 2014–2023
pmc-11703396.creator: Shih-Chang Tsai, Bing-Han Wan, Fuu-Jen Tsai, Jai-Sing Yang
pmc-11703396.description: IntroductionIn recent years, significant progress has been made in regenerative medicine, specifically in using mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) due to their regenerative and differentiating abilities. An exciting development in this area is the utilization of exosomes derived from MSCs, which have shown promise in tissue restoration, immune system modulation, and cancer treatment.

pmc-12422702.title: Impact of social franchising on TB contact investigation and uptake of TB preventive therapy
pmc-12422702.creator: M. Sheshi, B. Odume, O. Chukwuogo, C. Ogbudebe, I. Gordon, S. Useni, N. Nwokoye, M. Bajehson, D. Nongo, R. Eneogu, A. Ihesie, U. Omo-Emmanuel, S. Wadok, R. Furth, C. Anyaike
pmc-12422702.description: BACKGROUNDTB continues to pose significant public health challenges in high-burden regions such as Kano State, Nigeria, where private health sector engagement in TB control is notably lacking. The Social Franchising for TB Contact Investigation (SOFT) model was introduced to leverage private healthcare to increase the reach and efficacy of TB control efforts.

pmc-12440926.title: A nomogram model based on HALP score and sST2 for predicting 1-year MACE risk after PCI in acute myocardial infarction patients
pmc-12440926.creator: Chen-Yan Li, Hai-Bo Wu, Ya-Wei Duan, Peng Gao, Hong-Xiao Li, Xue-Chao Wang, Yun-Can Wang, Yan-Qing Wang, Shi-Ru Bai, Yuan Jia, Rong-Pin Du
pmc-12440926.description: ObjectiveTo develop a nomogram model integrating the HALP score (a composite score of hemoglobin, albumin, lymphocytes, and platelets) and sST2 for predicting the risk of major adverse cardiovascular events (MACE) within 1 year after percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) in patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI).

pmc-13136419.title: Sustainable thermal comfort assessment of evaporative cooling systems in hot and arid climates
pmc-13136419.creator: Ali Al-Jubainawi, Omar A M Mohammad, Ali Abbas Hashim Al-Maidi, Zahraa Abed Hussein, M A Abdelzaher
pmc-13136419.description: Rising global temperatures and urbanization have intensified the demand for sustainable cooling solutions, particularly in hot and arid climates such as Iraq, where conventional air conditioning exacerbates energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. Evaporative cooling provides an energy-efficient method to reduce ambient temperatures through water evaporation. However, their effectiveness is highly dependent on local climatic conditions.

pmc-13193072.title: Patient characteristics and lifestyle determinants of quality of life among women with endometriosis: a systematic review
pmc-13193072.creator: Zélia Breton, Giorgia Elisabeth Colombo, Nadjib Mokraoui, Yahya Mahamat-Saleh, Mathilde Pinault, Jacopo Conforti, Sabine Naudin, Maïa Alexaline, Marina Kvaskoff
pmc-13193072.description: Endometriosis is a chronic inflammatory disease presenting with debilitating symptoms strongly impacting patients’ quality of life (QoL). Assessing QoL is crucial for understanding the full patient experience beyond clinical symptoms. This narrative systematic review specifically aimed to identify and describe non-pharmacological and non-surgical factors associated with QoL in women with endometriosis as reported in the literature.

pmc-13195584.title: Music and trust formation: a scoping review of neurobiological convergence and research priorities
pmc-13195584.creator: Cairang Guanque, Shilei Huang, Xiyuan Wang, Xue Lei, Keyu Zhai, Chengyang Han, Frank Krueger
pmc-13195584.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionTrust is a cornerstone of human cooperation and social cohesion, while music is a universal phenomenon that promotes prosocial behavior and social bonding. Both music and trust processes engage overlapping neurobiological systems, yet their potential relationship remains largely unexplored.MethodsWe conducted a scoping review to systematically map existing research on music’s influence on trust formation, identify conceptual and methodological gaps, and characterize the current evidence base. The analysis included 15 empirical studies across interpersonal, clinical, robotic, and institutional trust contexts.

pmc-13318512.title: Computer Vision for Monitoring Wild Bees and Wasps: A Structured Literature Review
pmc-13318512.creator: Chenchang Liu, Patrick Mäder, Marco Seeland
pmc-13318512.description: Wild bees and wasps are vital to ecosystems, yet large‐scale monitoring of individual insects as well as their habitats and behaviors requires expert knowledge and is very labour‐intensive. Recent advances in computer vision offer both methodological solutions and practical applications for these tasks. This review systematically surveys state‐of‐the‐art literature (2020–2026) on computer‐vision‐based monitoring of wild bees and wasps.

pmc-13451507.title: Impact of gelatin supplementation on indices of skeletal muscle recovery: a pilot study
pmc-13451507.creator: Rebecca R. Graham, Brian E. Salgado, Emedel Guerrero, Ana P. Carrasco, Andrew C. D’Lugos
pmc-13451507.description: PurposeThis pilot study examined whether collagen supplementation, via gelatin, influences indices of skeletal muscle recovery following strenuous exercise.MethodsUsing a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled design, recreationally-active adults (25.9 ± 4.6 yrs.; 11 F, 11 M) consumed gelatin (GEL; 15 g) or placebo (PLA) twice daily. Participants performed 150 maximal unilateral eccentric knee extensions.

pmc-13588133.title: Letter to the Editor Regarding “Development and Internal Evaluation of a Nomogram for Clinically Significant Depressive Symptoms in Obstructive Sleep Apnea-Hypopnea Syndrome” [Letter]
pmc-13588133.creator: Rijuan Jin
pmc-13588133.description: ngle-center retrospective study of 820 hospitalized patients with PSG-confirmed OSAHS, the authors employed LASSO regression to select five predictors—ODI, PSQI, ESS, TSH, and FT3—from 36 candidate variables and constructed a nomogram for identifying clinically significant depressive symptoms as defined by an SDS standardized score ≥53. The model demonstrated favorable discrimination in the internal validation cohort (AUC = 0.915).
